related.description: Lightweight macOS desktop system monitor widget — live CPU, memory, disk, network, battery & process metrics. Swift + SwiftUI.
An oh-my-zsh plugin that configures proxy environment variables based on macOS's system preferences automatically
macOS system monitor in your menu bar
Monitor your Mac's fan speed and CPU/GPU temperature from your Notification Center.
Setup antigen with oh-my-zsh, powerlevel10k theme, fzf, autosuggestions, syntax-highlighting
